title: Birbal and the Half Reward
moral: Be fair and think before making decisions.

scenes.summary: A poor man seeks a reward for enduring the cold.
scenes.text: One day, a poor man came to Emperor Akbar and said he stood in a cold pond all night to earn a reward.
scenes.image_prompt: poor man speaking to king in court, winter scene cartoon

scenes.summary: Akbar refuses the reward due to a misunderstanding.
scenes.text: The man said he looked at a distant lamp. Akbar refused to reward him, saying the lamp gave him warmth.
scenes.image_prompt: king refusing reward while poor man looks sad, cartoon

scenes.summary: Birbal plans to show Akbar his mistake.
scenes.text: Birbal heard about the situation and decided to teach Akbar a lesson in fairness.
scenes.image_prompt: birbal thinking with thoughtful expression, cartoon style

scenes.summary: Birbal demonstrates the idea using cooking.
scenes.text: Birbal placed a pot high above a small fire. When Akbar questioned it, Birbal made a clever comparison.
scenes.image_prompt: pot hanging high above fire while king looks confused, cartoon

scenes.summary: Akbar realizes his mistake and rewards the man.
scenes.text: Akbar understood his mistake and rewarded the poor man. Be fair and think before making decisions.
scenes.image_prompt: king rewarding happy poor man while birbal smiles, cheerful cartoon

story: One day, a poor man came to Emperor Akbar and said he stood in a cold pond all night to earn a reward. When Akbar asked how he managed, the man said he looked at a distant lamp. Akbar refused to reward him. Birbal later placed a pot high above a fire to show that distant heat cannot cook food. Akbar realized his mistake and gave the poor man his reward.
